summary.headline: Numbered and Calculated Houses
summary.text: Kāsijī’s ephemeris practice of casting separate horoscopes for conjunctions and oppositions, followed by examples from Herat showing discrepancies between numbered and calculated tenth houses due to the meridian circle. The discussion extends these house-placement differences to the fourth, seventh, ninth, eleventh, and other houses under unequal house division.
